title: オスカー オードトワレ・スプレータイプ 100ml 【オスカー デ ラ レンタ】 (並行輸入品)
description: Oscar was the first perfume to be presented by Oscar de la Renta, created by Jean-Louis Sieuzac back in 1977. This is a classic, flowery, slightly sharp perfume of aromatic notes of lavender, rosemary and carnation, with sweet, powdery, musky base notes. The top notes of the fragrance include orange blossom, basil, coriander, galbanum, peach and gardenia. The heart of this arrangement encompasses ylang ylang, jasmine, tuberose, rose, rosemary, cyclamen, lavender and orchid. The base includes opoponax, carnation, patchouli, sandalwood, vetiver, lavender and amber. The perfume won FiFi Award back in 1978. The perfume was intended by Serge Mansau. It celebrated its 30th birthday in 2007. On this occasion a limited, jubilee version in a attractive bottle was launched. Nina Ricci is a French style house founded by Italian-born Maria "Nina" Ricci and her son Robert in 1932. Maria served as the house's designer and was known for her elegant, feminine gowns. Robert achieved the business and finance end, and made the initial foray into the perfume world. Nina Ricci's first fragrance, Coeur Joie, was introduced in 1946. The perfume was offered in a beautiful crystal bottle designed by Lalique, and marked the beginning of an historic partnership between the two businesses that would last many years. Nina Ricci has over 40 perfumes in their fragrance base. Nina Ricci is an old perfume house. The first edition was created back in 1946 and the newest is from 2012. Nina Ricci perfumes were made in partnership with perfumers Francis Fabron, Germaine Cellier, Jean Guichard, Givaudan, Cecile Matton, Aurelien Guichard, Olivier Cresp, Christine Nagel, Rosendo Mateu, Jacques Cavallier, Christian Vacchiano, Sophie Labbe, Carlos Benaim and Jacques Huclier.
